auth_details: API key or OAuth 2.0 access token via Authorization: Token token=YOUR_API_KEY (or Bearer for OAuth). For certain requests using an account-level API key, include From: user@example.com. This is generally unnecessary for user-level keys.
rate_limits: Generally 960 requests/minute per account API key, per user for user API keys, or per applicable OAuth app/user/account context; endpoint-specific exceptions may apply.
resolution_notes: auth.details: Auditor correct. Official REST API docs require a From header (user email) for some account-level API key requests, not From-Token. Evidence: https://developer.pagerduty.com/docs/rest-api-v2/authentication/ and https://developer.pagerduty.com/docs/ZG9jOjExMDI5NTUw-authentication. rate_limits: Auditor correct. Current official rate-limit guidance is 960 req/min (scope by credential type), not 900. Evidence: https://developer.pagerduty.com/docs/ZG9jOjExMDI5NTU4-rate-limiting and https://developer.pagerduty.com/docs/rest-api-v2/rate-limiting/.
